span.normalized: The Company is amortizing intangible assets of patents and technology rights related to a license agreement with STMicroelectronics International N.V. Amortization expense for intangible assets was $1.1 million, $3.2 million and $3.2 million for the years ended June 30, 2026, 2025 and 2024, respectively. The estimated useful lives for patents and technology rights and trade name were five years and ten years, respectively.
